title: SVG script element: HTML and SVG 2 point at each other, and HTML links to SVG Tiny 1.2
body:
About https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/902

While looking at how an external script in an inline SVG gets fetched, I followed the references between HTML and SVG 2 and they send you back and forth.

HTML, in the parser, for a `script` end tag in foreign content:

> If the active speculative HTML parser is null and the user agent supports SVG, then Process the SVG script element according to the SVG rules.

The link on "Process the SVG script element" goes to [SVG Tiny 1.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/SVGMobile12/script.html#ScriptContentProcessing).

SVG 2, [script element processing](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/interact.html#ScriptElementExecution):

> A script element must be processed as an HTML script element is, following prepare the script element [HTML], with its href attribute in place of the HTML src attribute.

So HTML says to look at SVG, and SVG says to look at HTML. But "prepare the script element" only talks about the HTML element and reads `src` directly. A few places where I can't tell what an SVG `script` element is supposed to do:

- [If el has no src attribute, and source text is the empty string, then return](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#script-processing-empty). Is `href` read there? SVG 2 defines [href on script](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/interact.html#ScriptElementHrefAttribute), and says the deprecated `xlink:href` is handled as in [Deprecated XLink URL reference attributes](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/linking.html#XLinkRefAttrs), so what happens when only `xlink:href` is present?
- [nomodule](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#attr-script-nomodule), [async](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#attr-script-async) and [defer](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#attr-script-defer) are all read by the algorithm (for example in [this step](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#script-processing-defer)). SVG 2 lists only `href`, `type`, `crossorigin` and `referrerpolicy` for `script`, so an SVG script element never has them (for now).
- [If el does not have a src content attribute, and the Should element's inline behavior be blocked by Content Security Policy? algorithm returns Blocked](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#script-processing-csp) and [If el has a src content attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#script-processing-src-prepare) are both keyed on `src`. For an SVG script with `href`, does the first one block it as inline, and does the second one run at all?

HTML already treats the SVG element as a script element elsewhere (document.currentScript, HTMLOrSVGScriptElement, setHTML). Only the processing is missing.

I suggest 
1. to fix the link to point to SVG 2, 
2. and to add a short note in "prepare the script element" saying that for an SVG script element `href` is used in place of `src` and the attributes it does not have are ignored. 

SVG 2 already defers to HTML for the rest. 
If you would rather have SVG 2 list the steps it overrides, I can write that side.
